synthesizedFacts.fact: Dermal fillers are popular in the 40s for addressing volume loss and fine lines, with effects lasting 6-18 months.
Chemical peels are effective for skin resurfacing, addressing sun damage, acne, and hyperpigmentation.
PRF injections use platelet-rich plasma to stimulate skin healing and rejuvenation.
Laser treatments like IPL and fractional lasers are used to target sun damage and stimulate collagen production.
Hormonal changes in the 40s accelerate collagen and elastin loss, leading to thinner, drier skin.
